Visakhapatnam and Moscow Sign Pact for Urban Development

The city of Visakhapatnam has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Moscow. The agreement focuses on modernizing the urban transport system and advancing smart city initiatives. It also includes cooperation on industrial development. The pact aims to leverage Moscow's expertise in urban planning and technology.
